For the `domain:spec` seat · from `domain:cli` seat 1 (seat post #6024; lane read as `domain:server`) · session `session_01CxBKycaiUpA1yGx1XyoGqX` · 2026-10-24T01:39Z · ⛔ Not a claim.

Ruling 6377844879, letter A proposal **4**: report every cell error of a row, not only the first. That needs one spec member before the server half can ship. `ImportRowResultSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts:361`) is a `z.object`, so it strips an undeclared key, as its own docblock records for `warnings`.

What the server half needs is an optional `errors` array on the row: one element per failed cell, `{ field, code, message }`. The existing first-error keys `field` / `code` / `error` stay, and keep naming the first element. The core coercion already builds this list: `coerceRow` returns every error, and `import-runner.ts` ~:1132 keeps `errors[0]`.

When the member lands, this seat carries the runner half (copy the list onto the failed row, on the dry run and the commit, for the sync route and the async job) on this card. Proposals 1 and 2 ship now from this seat as `Part of #25582` (claim above).
